start.text: Oh — a detective, are you? I wondered when someone official might show up. There's been... odd goings-on around here.

choices.text: When did you last see the master of the house?
Stop wasting my time. Tell me everything, now.

pressured.text: I beg your pardon! I am trying to help, Detective. Push like that again and you'll hear nothing more from me.

shut_down.text: That's quite enough. I have nothing more to say to you. Good day.

start_friendly.text: Detective — good, you've come back. I've been thinking about what you asked. There's something else I ought to tell you.

choices.text: Thank you. I'll keep it in mind.

hostile_start.text: I've said all I intend to say. Come back when you've earned a measure of trust around here.

odd_goings.text: Two nights past I heard something — a dragging sound, like. From the east wing. I told myself it was rats. Very large rats.

choices.text: Thank you. I'll look into it.

time_question.text: Past midnight, certainly. The gas lamps had been turned low — I had to feel my way down the corridor.

saw_anyone.text: A shape, only. Tall, in a long coat. Could have been anyone. Could have been the master himself, for all I know.

choices.text: The master — has he been acting strangely?

ask_master_behaviour.text: I've perhaps said too much already. Earn a bit more trust first, Detective.

choices.text: I insist. What do you know?

ask_owner.text: Three days ago. He left in a great hurry — no luggage, no word to the staff. That's what worries me most.

choices.text: Was anyone else present when he left?

no_note.text: Nothing — I checked his desk myself. Though... the drawer had been forced. Someone had been through his papers before I reached them.

choices.text: Did you report this to the constables?
Who else has access to the study?

constables.text: Constable Webb came round. Took one look and declared it 'probably nothing.' He could barely wait to be gone.

choices.text: Thank you. This has been very helpful.

odd_officer.text: That's precisely what I thought. Something's rotten here, Detective. I hope you find it before it finds us.

grateful_end.text: Of course. The door at the back — I've left it unlocked for you. See what you make of the east wing.

choices.text: Thank you. I'll have a look.

study_access.text: The master, myself, and Mr. Harlow — his solicitor. Harlow visited the very day before the disappearance.

about_harlow.text: A cold sort. Always watching. The master relied on him completely, which I never understood.

harlow_location.text: He keeps an office near the station. Above the tobacconist's on Marsh Street. Number fourteen.

others_present.text: Mr. Harlow was here that morning. They argued — I heard raised voices through the study door. Then the master was simply... gone.

argument_content.text: I couldn't make out the words. Only the tone. The master sounded frightened. I've not heard him sound frightened before.
